title: Prune the Summary, Not the History: Source-Judged Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents rely on context compaction: when the interaction history outgrows the context window, a compressor replaces it with a natural-language summary. We show that these summaries contain more than a record of what happened. Compaction prompts ask for decisions and next steps, so each summary mixes facts established by the environment with reasoning written by the compressor, and the agent cannot tell the two apart afterwards. In an analysis of a widely used structured compressor, 83% of failed runs trace back to an action that carries out a specific summary entry, most of which no environment output supports. We propose Source-Judged Compaction (SJC), a training-free post-processing step that scores each summary entry for whether it has a source in the environment outputs or the previous summary, and removes the entries that do not. It changes neither the agent nor the compressor and adds one inexpensive judge request p

translated_title: 修剪摘要，而非历史：面向长程智能体的来源判定式压缩
translated_abstract: 长程LLM智能体依赖上下文压缩：当交互历史超出上下文窗口时，压缩器会将其替换为一份自然语言摘要。我们证明，这些摘要所包含的内容远不止是对已发生事件的记录。压缩提示词要求总结决策和下一步行动，因此每份摘要都混杂了环境所确立的事实与压缩器自行撰写的推理，而智能体事后无法区分二者。在对一个广泛使用的结构化压缩器的分析中，83%的失败运行可追溯至执行了某个特定摘要条目的动作，而其中大多数条目并没有任何环境输出的支持。我们提出来源判定式压缩，这是一种免训练的后处理步骤，为每条摘要条目评分，判断其在环境输出或先前摘要中是否存在来源依据，并删除没有来源的条目。该方法既不改变智能体也不改变压缩器，仅增加一次成本极低的判定请求……
tldr: 提出免训练的来源判定式压缩（SJC）方法，通过检验摘要条目是否能在环境输出或先前摘要中找到来源依据，剔除缺乏事实支撑的摘要内容，从而大幅提升长程LLM智能体的运行可靠性。
en_tdlr: Source-Judged Compaction (SJC) is a training-free post-processing method that prunes summary entries lacking grounding in environment outputs or previous summaries, significantly improving the reliability of long-horizon LLM agents.
